record_id.description: the opaque record id exactly as the file names it

judgeable.description: false when the record has no narrative surface to judge; the five questions must then be null

has_contradicted_information.description: true when any factual statement conflicts with the payload: wrong value, wrong hour, wrong entity, wrong direction of change

has_unsupported_information.description: true when any factual statement names something the payload has no field for; advisory and limitation sentences never count here

critical_events_complete.description: true only when every required critical event of this case, that is every event of kind transition or final_outcome, is conveyed at the right hour and about the right entity. Disclosures are NOT judged here

required_disclosures_complete.description: true only when every required disclosure of this case, that is every event of kind policy_disclosure, is present. Judged on those events and on nothing else

advice_grounded_and_caveated.description: NOT_APPLICABLE only when no recommendation is offered and the gold records advice as optional

limitations_complete.description: true only when every required limitation element is present in substance

stage_c_pass.description: the conjunction defined in the rubric; null when judgeable is false

failures.description: one entry for every question that came out as a failure; empty when the record passes

exact_quote.description: the offending words from the answer, verbatim; empty only when the failure is an omission

payload_evidence.description: the payload field, row or period that establishes the failure, or the event_id or element_id that was not satisfied

uncalibrated_fuels_mentioned.description: recorded only, never part of stage_c_pass: does the answer describe the fuels as uncalibrated

initial_state_conveyed.description: recorded only, never part of stage_c_pass: does the answer correctly convey the situation at hour 0. False when it says nothing about hour 0, and false plus a question-1 failure when it says something wrong about it

note.description: one sentence; for an unjudgeable record, why
